name: eurus-skills
description: A store for the eurus-labs plugins, with install and update for Copilot CLI and Claude Code, eval scores, and eval runs for contributors.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In an untrusted workspace the extension still shows the store and installs plugins, but it does not start the eval engine, which runs a Python script from the workspace.

eurusSkills.theme.description: The palette of the store and the plugin page. Ignored in a high-contrast VS Code theme, which uses its own colors.

eurusSkills.catalogUrl.description: Where the catalog is fetched from when the open folder is not a checkout of the eurus-labs marketplace. Must be an https:// URL.

eurusSkills.confirmInstalls.description: Ask before an install, update or enable command runs in a terminal. Uninstall always asks.

eurusSkills.python.description: The Python 3.9 or later that runs tools/skill_manager.py, the eval engine, in a checkout of the marketplace.

eurusSkills.evalMaxCostUsd.description: The cost ceiling in US dollars passed to a Claude Code eval run. Over 0 and at most 50.
